items.finding: Round-2 review made all four follow-up approaches comparable in scope while retaining the 2025 primary federal recommendation and correcting the brief-referral-only misconception.

items.source_name: American Psychiatric Association — Prolonged Grief Disorder
items.source_locator: Symptoms and Diagnosis: persistent intense longing and/or preoccupation with the deceased with significant distress or functional impairment; for adults the death must have occurred at least one year earlier, and diagnosis requires the full DSM-5-TR criteria with cultural context considered.
items.source_version: APA page physician-reviewed August 2025; DSM-5-TR (2022) remains current and includes prolonged grief disorder; live-rechecked 2026-08-15.
items.finding: Fresh audit verified the current DSM-5-TR term and 12-month adult threshold against APA's physician-reviewed August 2025 guidance and preserved 'evaluate' rather than making a diagnosis from the stem alone.
